title: Grateful Dead Live at Soldiers & Sailors Memorial Auditorium on 1969-02-05
lineage: SBD > MC > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard capture of a high‑energy Feb 5 '69 show, highlighted by a scorching Eleven→Caution suite and a powerful Dark Star despite occasional muffled mix and the abrupt end to Cryptical.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised for its incendiary Eleven into Caution sequence, a fiery Dark Star, and an overall electric vibe that turned many first‑time listeners into lifelong Deadheads. The soundboard tape is generally considered good for its era, though reviewers note some muddiness, occasional cut‑offs (notably the end of Cryptical) and missing audience ambience. Even with those flaws the show shines as a quintessential early‑1969 snapshot.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and extol the music, especially the Eleven→Caution suite; technical complaints are present but not enough to outweigh the strong performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally solid for a 1969 soundboard: clear overall, but noted as slightly muffled/muddy in places, with occasional drop‑outs and an abrupt cut at the end of Cryptical.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑Feb ’69 energy with tight jams, strong transitions (DS→SS→Eleven), and a high‑octane second half; occasional interruptions but overall a powerful, flowing set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for shredding guitar work, especially on the Eleven jam.
